subject: Milestone-based co-sell payout and lead maturity verification
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Carlson <sara.carlson@auroraanalytics.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@auroraanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial proposal: milestone-based co-sell payouts & lead maturity

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — really excited about the potential for Aurora Analytics to integrate Redwood’s inference platform as a value-add for your ML ops product line. Per our ask, I put together a lightweight proposal for a milestone-based commercial structure that aligns payouts to activation and expansion signals rather than just one-time booking commissions.

High level proposal (attached spreadsheet has model):
- 40% on contract execution (signature)
- 30% on first production inference (>=100k tokens/month for 1 month)
- 20% on 3-month retention (>=75k tokens/month avg over months 2–4)
- 10% on achieving first upsell (new paid route or seat expansion within 12 months)

Lead maturity rules for credit:
- Leads must be registered in HubSpot with a mutual action plan (MAP) doc
- Aurora must own initial SDR/demo touch and include Redwood in RFP / procurement conversations
- Payouts only apply when purchase is placed against a Redwood SKU in the order

I've attached a Mutual Action Plan draft and a payout model for transparency. Would you like us to run a few scenarios with your typical deal sizes? Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: co-sell-payout-model.xlsx (spreadsheet — payout tiers + examples)

Thanks Karthik — this looks promising. A few quick clarifying questions before we loop in our procurement:

1) What counts as "first production inference"? Is that per-customer or per-account? We run pilots that sometimes pass 50k tokens/day for two weeks and then pause.
2) For the retention milestone, can we pro-rate if usage ramps slowly over the first quarter?
3) For lead registration: do you require a signed MAP before we demo, or is the MAP just a post-demo administrative step?

Also, can you share any precedent with other ISV partners who have used milestone payouts? Would be helpful when I brief our CFO.

—Tom

Karthik / team — see inline answers and recommended legal/ops language. I also attached a version of the payout model with two alternate waterfalls (Conservative / Accelerator) so Aurora can choose based on risk tolerance.

Inline:
- "First production inference" — define as first month where production usage >=100k tokens AND the customer is on a paid Redwood subscription (no temporary trial credits). If a pilot touches 50k/day but isn't converted to paid, it does NOT qualify.
- Retention pro-rate — we can allow a 90-day ramp window. If usage doesn't hit the 3-month threshold by day 90, payout for that tier is reduced pro-rata based on average monthly tokens compared to threshold.
- MAP timing — MAP should be recorded at lead registration in HubSpot. It does not need to be signed before the demo, but it must be present in the record before we pay the contract-execution tranche.
- Evidence & payout timing — payouts are paid upon receipt of: signed order referencing Redwood SKU, HubSpot MAP record, and automated usage export (CSV) from Redwood showing the milestone. Payment processed on next monthly partner payout run (Net-30 after evidence).
- Clawbacks — 12-month churn clawback on the 40% contract tranche; if the account cancels within 12 months, we reclaim that tranche pro-rata.

Ops notes (Marissa): please confirm downstream accounting entries required and if we need a new partner payout code for milestone-based deals.

Camila Reyes
Senior Channel Lead | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Attachment: co-sell-payout-model.xlsx (Conservative & Accelerator sheets)

Subject: Final: Milestone payout proposal, MAP, and next steps

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks for the questions and patience while our ops/legal teams weighed in. Attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the payout workbook that contains two options (Conservative / Accelerator). Summary of the version we recommend for early ISV partners like Aurora: 

Recommended (Accelerator) summary: 
- 40% on signed order (paid Net-30, clawback pro-rata if cancelled in 12 months)
- 30% on first production month (>=100k tokens, paid upon automated evidence)
- 20% on 3-month rolling retention (>=75k tokens/month average over months 2–4)
- 10% on first commercial upsell (within 12 months)

Evidence checklist to trigger payouts: 
1) Signed PO / Order referencing Redwood SKU
2) HubSpot MAP record (registration + timestamp)
3) Usage export (CSV) from Redwood with account id and token counts

Next steps:
- Please review the attached MAP and tell us which payout waterfall you prefer (Conservative vs Accelerator).
- If you approve, we can put these terms in a simple Partner Addendum and have procurement sign the MAP + Addendum.
- I'll coordinate a short 30-min call with our finance ops to walk through payout timing and required PO fields.

Can you confirm by EOD Thursday if Aurora prefers Accelerator? If not, we'll proceed with Conservative by default.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Karthik Iyer
